newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sentrachem plans one bln rand debt cut.
newsitem.headline: Sentrachem plans one bln rand debt cut.

text.p: South African chemicals group Sentrachem Ltd said on Tuesday a restructuring plan would see the group reduce debt by about one billion rand over the next 12 to 18 months.

Other elements of the restructure include Sentrachem undertaking a feasibility study on the listing of an international speciality chemicals business in London or New York, anchored around its U.S-based Hampshire Chemical Corp.
Sentrachem said that the revamp is subject to the listing requirements of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange as well as other necessary regulatory and shareholder approvals.
Job said that the group will make further announcements on the progress of implementing the proposals.
